name: Micro Scooter Challenge
summary:
Scooter Challenge is a studio-produced IncaGold arcade game in which the player can try their hand at racing on a scooter. Race routes run through London, New York, Cairo, Rio de Janeiro and Sydney. The creators took care of several variants of the game, including the option of multi-player competition.

The first PC game to bring the popular world of Micro Scooter to life. Race around manyworld - wide locations, from Trafalgar Square, London, to the Olympic Stadium, Berlin.

Use your skills to outrun the opposition and watch out for the ramps and power - ups to help you get ahead of the competition.

* Multiple camera angles and stunning graphics

* 7 great locations in a variety of weather conditions; from bright sunshine to snow

* Race against your friends in multi-player mode over LAN for up to 8 players
